scope: Runtime-owned repairs; independent audit merges final clause IDs

items.disposition: Future reaction queue expiry is max(due,now)+6h; completed immutable checkpoints prevent job recreation after queue retention.

Scheduler and event tools share event:kind:due key; expired verification windows are not recreated. Accepted primary outcome/quote history clears next milestone; matching delivered snapshot consumes resolution flag.
Removed code publisher and extra PUBLISH_PARTIAL runtime job. Classification exposes partial_required/deadline to existing analyst; normal publish_card is sole publication path.

Backup runs as separately supervised asyncio task; copy offloaded to thread with cooperative cancellation before generation shutdown. Logs optional path handled; independent partition maintenance does not depend on backup.
Operational scans keyset paged; recent truth time bounded; scouts checkpoint successful passes and use latest baseline samples without whole truth history materialization.
Reaction compute_market_truth offloaded with asyncio.to_thread; immutable append revisions require explicit reason.
Explicit tank capture runs source and BASE market acquisition before Jev calibration; serve still refuses null cutoffs. Registry synchronized from canonical config at startup.
Startup and idle reconciliation catch FAILED/EXPIRED jobs terminated outside handlers; worker terminal errors append idempotent terminal FAILED and deterministic ops notice.
Scheduler reads heartbeat UTC, call expiry, event closure, HOT cap, base/raw/jobs/archive retention from frozen YAML.

HLD backup assets are a required minimum, not an exclusive list (parent ruling). Both database dumps plus complete nonsecret referenced evidence/config/logs are copied and verified; extra evidence coverage is disclosed. No unspecified backup purge/rotation policy is invented.
Immutable exact config capture, honest commit/dirty identity and validated SIGHUP generation replacement are implemented; code version remains process pinned.

PRE windows retain exact historical start→anchor semantics. Latest analysis_set plus benchmarks selects tokens. Canonical stable RWP-ULID allocated once per event/token group; old immutable composite IDs retained as legacy audit.

Scheduler and MarketService share event/token-scoped hot_protected and refresh_hot_expiry domain APIs: matching OPEN/unexpired ARMED gives NULL; otherwise anchor+72h. Cap counts unique tokens and reads YAML.
Canonical milestone key aligned; event tool priority/retry/minute-key and market-ready followup semantics remain event-tools/market owned.
Backup/log environment examples supplied. Destination secrets currently Settings/env; delivery.yaml destination fallback and User-Agent exact contract require configuration owner disposition.
First successful SENT persists ALERTED; a later scheduler lifecycle pass persists MONITORING. Stable reaction IDs use RWP-ULID; util aliases provide canonical uppercase entity prefixes.
Raw cleanup now preserves every instrument on UTC days overlapping any MAJOR+ window, matching storage partition policy; metadata remains permanent.

Automatic historical completion and ordinary live late normalized arrivals emit durable capture_changes. Indexed arrival/semantic queries and lightweight checkpoint metadata coalesce changes. Scheduler enqueues reasoned immutable revisions; actual worker appends latest+1 only for changed semantic checkpoint fingerprints and durably acknowledges unchanged/duplicate data.
CLI SIGHUP and RuntimeSupervisor validate candidate before draining old generation, preserve durable jobs/session cursors and reject unsupported live storage moves.

RUN_MARKET_TRUTH checks exact event/token/anchor durable capture state. PendingBackfill defers without attempt or TTL consumption; terminal PARTIAL/FAILED proceeds actual truth with explicit capture status.
